entities.summary: Michelle M. Marciniak is a former All-American collegiate and professional basketball player who played point guard in the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). As a floor general, Marciniak competed for two national championships during her three-year career at the University of Tennessee. She led the Tennessee Lady Vols to their fourth national championship and, in 1996, was named most valuable player in the Final Four Women's Tournament in Charlotte, North Carolina.
